label: Immunoglobulins are beneficial in SARS-CoV-2 vaccine-induced small fibre neuropathy even 3 years after onset.
summary: SARS-CoV-2 vaccination (SC2V) can be complicated by post-acute COVID-19 vaccination syndrome (PACVS). One manifestation of PACVS is small fibre neuropathy (SFN). A positive effect of intravenous immunoglobulins (IVIGs) even 3 years after the onset of PACVS is not known.
